title: Major modernization — Dark mode, Clients, Recurring services & Notifications
summary: A large modernization pass that refactors the architecture, adds dark mode with theme persistence, introduces client management with visit tracking, recurring service scheduling with automatic reminders, and an in-app notification system.
changes: Architecture: Introduced IFinanceService interface — all pages now depend on an abstraction instead of the concrete store, making future backend swaps straightforward.
Architecture: Removed the legacy LocalApiMessageHandler HTTP-faking layer and unused AnalyticsDtos.cs; the store is now called directly.
Dark mode: Added a full light/dark theme toggle (sun/moon icon in the top bar) with automatic localStorage persistence.
Dark mode: All CSS variables, cards, modals, tables, charts, hero sections, and PWA banners respect the selected theme.
Dark mode: Chart.js graphs now read CSS variables for grid lines and text, so they adapt to light or dark automatically.
Error handling: Wrapped the main content area in an ErrorBoundary with a friendly recovery UI.
Client management: New Clients page with full add/edit/delete, search/filter, and a detailed drill-down panel showing visit history and spending.
Client management: New ClientSelector autocomplete component used on Record Service and Product Sales pages.
Client management: Existing records with client names were automatically migrated to proper client records (schema v2).
Recurring services: New Recurring page to set up repeating weekly, biweekly, or monthly appointments per worker/service/client.
Recurring services: Due and overdue items are highlighted in the table with a one-click 'Mark done' button that auto-advances the next date.
Notifications: New notification bell in the top bar with a badge count and dropdown panel.
Notifications: Automatic alerts for overdue recurring services and low-stock products (≤ 3 remaining) — refreshed on every data change.
Data schema upgraded to v3 with automatic migration from older versions.
